# ForgeFlow Legal Pack Acceptance Terms

**Version:** `2026-09-IR-2`

The ForgeFlow Legal Gate now covers the following versioned repository documents as one Legal Pack:

1. [Developer / IP / Confidentiality Agreement](./FORGEFLOW_DEVELOPER_IP_CONFIDENTIALITY_AGREEMENT.md)
2. [Engineering Access & Security Policy](./FORGEFLOW_ENGINEERING_ACCESS_SECURITY_POLICY.md)
3. [Pre-Existing IP Disclosure](./FORGEFLOW_PRE_EXISTING_IP_DISCLOSURE.md)
4. [Offboarding / Return / Deletion Acknowledgement](./FORGEFLOW_OFFBOARDING_RETURN_DELETION_ACKNOWLEDGEMENT.md)

These documents are adapted for the current pre-incorporation ForgeFlow startup structure, with **Hossein Rahimi** as Founder/current recipient of transferable/economic ForgeFlow project rights and the **laws of the Islamic Republic of Iran** as governing law.

They supplement, and do not replace, mandatory employment rights or any separately signed employment, contractor, compensation or services agreement.

## What acceptance confirms

By posting one of the exact Legal Gate statements below from the same GitHub account that authors the pull request, the Developer confirms that they have read and accept the current Legal Pack, including the confidentiality, economic-rights, security, third-party material, future-company and offboarding provisions.

Repository access, commits, pull requests, reviews, authorship attribution or contributor status do **not** by themselves create equity, partnership, revenue share, co-founder status, governance rights or commercial ownership in ForgeFlow.

Nothing in this Legal Pack purports to transfer or waive moral rights that are non-transferable under Iranian law.

## Acceptance option A: no relevant pre-existing IP

Post exactly:

`I have read and accept the ForgeFlow Legal Pack v2026-09-IR-2. Pre-Existing IP: NONE.`

## Acceptance option B: pre-existing IP disclosed separately

If relevant pre-existing material exists, disclose the details privately to Hossein Rahimi and post exactly:

`I have read and accept the ForgeFlow Legal Pack v2026-09-IR-2. Pre-Existing IP: DISCLOSED SEPARATELY.`

For option B, the Legal Gate remains pending until **@HoosseinRahimi** posts the version-specific approval statement generated by the workflow. Sensitive disclosure details should not be posted in the source repository.

## Electronic record

The parties intend the authenticated GitHub acceptance, together with the account identity, timestamp, pull-request record and retained versioned text, to form an electronic record of acknowledgement. This repository mechanism does not claim to satisfy every possible higher evidentiary standard for a secure electronic signature; a dedicated e-signature service may still be used for higher-risk engagements.

## Governing law and mandatory protections

This Legal Pack is governed by the laws of the **Islamic Republic of Iran**. Mandatory labour, social-security, tax, intellectual-property and other non-waivable rules continue to apply according to the actual relationship between the parties.

## Version changes

Acceptance applies only to `2026-09-IR-2`. A material update requires a new version and fresh Legal Gate acceptance.
